answer: Make each agent lock a refundable bond before trading, and earn reputation only through completed, peer-checked jobs over time. Like a willow rooted in one place, standing stays tied to a single history and cannot be copied to a fresh account. Random audits slash the bond of anyone caught faking work, with each outcome written to a public jade record that peers can inspect. A violet flag marks clusters of new accounts acting together for closer review. Creating many fakes then costs a bond plus weeks of waiting per identity, while honest agents keep their stake.
